WITH txn_visitors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn_visitors

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS ts,
    date,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) AS rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, 
  UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ts, date
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT 
    ts,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK) AS wk,
    SUM(rev) AS wrev
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY ts, wk
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    ts,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS mn,
    SUM(rev) AS mrev
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY ts, mn
),
top AS (
  SELECT ts FROM daily GROUP BY ts ORDER BY SUM(rev) DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  t.ts AS traffic_source,
  (SELECT MAX(d.rev) FROM daily d WHERE d.ts = t.ts) / 1000000000.0 AS max_daily_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(w.wrev) FROM weekly w WHERE w.ts = t.ts) / 1000000000.0 AS max_weekly_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(m.mrev) FROM monthly m WHERE m.ts = t.ts) / 1000000000.0 AS max_monthly_millions
FROM top t

WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    totals.transactions,
    totals.pageviews,
    DATE(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date)) as session_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date)), MONTH) as session_month,
    (SELECT ANY_VALUE(p.productRevenue) FROM UNNEST(hits) h CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) p) as has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
)
SELECT 
  session_month,
  CASE 
    WHEN transactions IS NOT NULL AND transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN transactions IS NULL AND has_product_revenue IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
    ELSE 'other'
  END as session_type,
  COUNT(*) as session_count,
  AVG(pageviews) as avg_pageviews
FROM session_data
GROUP BY session_month, session_type
ORDER BY session_month, session_type

-- Final query: Top product by quantity among YouTube-brand-product buyers
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductCategory) LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
    AND totals.transactions > 0
)
SELECT 
  p.v2ProductName,
  CAST(SUM(p.productQuantity) AS INT64) as total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
JOIN youtube_buyers yb ON s.fullVisitorId = yb.fullVisitorId
, UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE s._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.v2ProductName != '(not set)'
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', dc.date) as date
FROM daily_counts dc
CROSS JOIN stats s
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) = 2

WITH sessions_filter AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, visitNumber, visitStartTime,
         hits
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND LOWER(trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
),
page_hits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, visitNumber, visitStartTime,
         h.hitNumber, h.time, h.page.pagePath, h.type
  FROM sessions_filter,
  UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE h.page.pagePath IS NOT NULL AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_page_hits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, time, pagePath,
         LEAD(pagePath) OVER(PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) as next_page,
         LEAD(time) OVER(PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) as next_time
  FROM page_hits
  WHERE LOWER(pagePath) LIKE '/home%'
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT next_page, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM home_page_hits
  WHERE next_page IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY next_page
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT CAST(ROUND(MAX((next_time - time) / 1000.0)) AS INT64) as max_time_seconds
  FROM home_page_hits
  WHERE next_page IS NOT NULL
),
top_next_page AS (
  SELECT next_page
  FROM next_page_counts
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT next_page FROM top_next_page) as most_common_next_page,
  (SELECT max_time_seconds FROM max_time) as max_time_on_home_seconds

SELECT 
  source,
  MAX(monthly_revenue) as max_monthly,
  MIN(monthly_revenue) as min_monthly,
  ROUND((MAX(monthly_revenue) - MIN(monthly_revenue)) / 1000000.0, 2) as diff_in_millions
FROM (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source, month
)
GROUP BY source

WITH customers_who_bought_henley AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
    WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(h.product) AS p
      WHERE p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
      AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
    )
  )
),
product_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.v2ProductName,
    SUM(p.productQuantity) as total_quantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` t,
  customers_who_bought_henley c,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE t.fullVisitorId = c.fullVisitorId
    AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
    AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
  GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, total_quantity
FROM product_sales
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0)
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE u7.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM users_2day)

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date, new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
),
growth AS (
  SELECT date, new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) AS growth_rate
  FROM daily
  WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS date_mmdd, new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed, growth_rate
FROM growth
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS city_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY city_discharges DESC

-- Final answer: exactly 1 row - the route with longest avg bike duration among those faster than taxis
WITH top_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name,
        end_station_name,
        ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as s_lat,
        ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as s_lon,
        ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as e_lat,
        ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as e_lon,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
        AND tripduration > 0
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, 
             ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3), ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3),
             ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3), ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3)
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        tr.start_station_name,
        tr.end_station_name,
        tr.s_lat, tr.s_lon, tr.e_lat, tr.e_lon,
        tr.trip_count as bike_trip_count,
        tr.avg_bike_duration,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM top_routes tr
    LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
        ON ROUND(t.pickup_longitude, 3) = tr.s_lon
        AND ROUND(t.pickup_latitude, 3) = tr.s_lat
        AND ROUND(t.dropoff_longitude, 3) = tr.e_lon
        AND ROUND(t.dropoff_latitude, 3) = tr.e_lat
        AND t.pickup_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND t.dropoff_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND t.trip_distance > 0
    GROUP BY tr.start_station_name, tr.end_station_name, tr.s_lat, tr.s_lon, tr.e_lat, tr.e_lon, tr.trip_count, tr.avg_bike_duration
)
SELECT 
    start_station_name,
    end_station_name,
    ROUND(avg_bike_duration, 2) as avg_bike_duration
FROM taxi_matches
WHERE avg_bike_duration < avg_taxi_duration
    AND avg_taxi_duration IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_seconds / 60.0 AS trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND trip_seconds >= 0
    AND trip_seconds <= 3600
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  ROUND(MIN(trip_minutes)) AS min_trip_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(trip_minutes)) AS max_trip_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS avg_fare
FROM with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

SELECT 
    c.geo_id as census_tract,
    ROUND(AVG(f.transaction_amt), 2) as avg_donation,
    ROUND(c.median_income, 2) as median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` f
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` crosswalk
    ON f.zip_code = crosswalk.zip_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` c
    ON crosswalk.census_tract_geoid = c.geo_id
WHERE f.state = 'NY' 
    AND c.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
GROUP BY c.geo_id, c.median_income
ORDER BY c.geo_id

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1.0) * COALESCE(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) as subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0) * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) as macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c 
    ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    AND p.inventory_year = c.inventory_year
    AND p.state_code = c.state_code
    AND p.survey_unit_code = c.survey_unit_code
    AND p.county_code = c.county_code
    AND p.phase_2_plot_number = c.phase_2_plot_number
  WHERE p.inventory_year = 2012
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group_description as evaluation_group,
  evaluation_type,
  condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  CAST(state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
  ROUND(macroplot_acres, 2) as macroplot_acres,
  ROUND(subplot_acres, 2) as subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    a.country_name,
    SUM(a.population) AS pop_under_20,
    b.midyear_population,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(a.population), b.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` b
    ON a.country_code = b.country_code AND a.country_name = b.country_name AND a.year = b.year
WHERE a.year = 2020 AND a.age < 20
GROUP BY a.country_name, b.midyear_population
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT country_name, 
       SUM(cumulative_confirmed) as total_confirmed, 
       SUM(cumulative_recovered) as total_recovered,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cumulative_recovered), SUM(cumulative_confirmed)) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE date = '2020-05-10'
  AND country_name IS NOT NULL
  AND aggregation_level = 1
GROUP BY country_name
HAVING total_confirmed > 50000
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH daily_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' AND year = '2019' AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
converted AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wind_ms
  FROM daily_data
  WHERE temp_f != 9999.9 AND prcp_in != 99.99 AND wdsp_knots != 999.9
),
moving_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wind_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS ma_temp_c,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS ma_prcp_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(wind_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS ma_wind_ms
  FROM converted
)
SELECT 
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wind_ms,
  ma_temp_c,
  ma_prcp_cm,
  ma_wind_ms,
  ROUND(ma_temp_c - LAG(ma_temp_c, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_temp,
  ROUND(ma_temp_c - LAG(ma_temp_c, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_temp,
  ROUND(ma_temp_c - LAG(ma_temp_c, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_temp,
  ROUND(ma_temp_c - LAG(ma_temp_c, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_temp,
  ROUND(ma_temp_c - LAG(ma_temp_c, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_temp,
  ROUND(ma_temp_c - LAG(ma_temp_c, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_temp,
  ROUND(ma_temp_c - LAG(ma_temp_c, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_temp,
  ROUND(ma_temp_c - LAG(ma_temp_c, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_temp,
  ROUND(ma_prcp_cm - LAG(ma_prcp_cm, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_prcp,
  ROUND(ma_prcp_cm - LAG(ma_prcp_cm, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_prcp,
  ROUND(ma_prcp_cm - LAG(ma_prcp_cm, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_prcp,
  ROUND(ma_prcp_cm - LAG(ma_prcp_cm, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_prcp,
  ROUND(ma_prcp_cm - LAG(ma_prcp_cm, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_prcp,
  ROUND(ma_prcp_cm - LAG(ma_prcp_cm, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_prcp,
  ROUND(ma_prcp_cm - LAG(ma_prcp_cm, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_prcp,
  ROUND(ma_prcp_cm - LAG(ma_prcp_cm, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_prcp,
  ROUND(ma_wind_ms - LAG(ma_wind_ms, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_wind,
  ROUND(ma_wind_ms - LAG(ma_wind_ms, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_wind,
  ROUND(ma_wind_ms - LAG(ma_wind_ms, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_wind,
  ROUND(ma_wind_ms - LAG(ma_wind_ms, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_wind,
  ROUND(ma_wind_ms - LAG(ma_wind_ms, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_wind,
  ROUND(ma_wind_ms - LAG(ma_wind_ms, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_wind,
  ROUND(ma_wind_ms - LAG(ma_wind_ms, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_wind,
  ROUND(ma_wind_ms - LAG(ma_wind_ms, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_wind
FROM moving_averages
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 20

-- Complete query: find second longest distance storm in 2020 NA and get its final latitude
WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season,
    usa_latitude, usa_longitude,
    iso_time,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(usa_longitude, usa_latitude) AS geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA'
),
consecutive AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season,
    iso_time,
    geom,
    LEAD(geom) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS next_geom
  FROM storm_points
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season,
    SUM(ST_DISTANCE(geom, next_geom)) AS total_distance_meters
  FROM consecutive
  WHERE next_geom IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sid, name, season
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season, total_distance_meters,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC) AS rank
  FROM distances
),
second_storm AS (
  SELECT sid, name, season
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rank = 2
),
final_coords AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.sid, sp.name, sp.usa_latitude, sp.usa_longitude, sp.iso_time
  FROM storm_points sp
  JOIN second_storm ss ON sp.sid = ss.sid
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.sid ORDER BY sp.iso_time DESC) = 1
)
SELECT fc.usa_latitude AS final_latitude, fc.usa_longitude AS final_longitude, fc.iso_time, ss.name
FROM final_coords fc
JOIN second_storm ss ON fc.sid = ss.sid

SELECT
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * 2 * ATAN2(
      SQRT(
        SIN((SAFE_CAST(st_end.latitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(st_start.latitude AS FLOAT64)) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2) * SIN((SAFE_CAST(st_end.latitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(st_start.latitude AS FLOAT64)) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2) +
        COS(SAFE_CAST(st_start.latitude AS FLOAT64) * ACOS(-1) / 180) * COS(SAFE_CAST(st_end.latitude AS FLOAT64) * ACOS(-1) / 180) *
        SIN((SAFE_CAST(st_end.longitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(st_start.longitude AS FLOAT64)) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2) * SIN((SAFE_CAST(st_end.longitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(st_start.longitude AS FLOAT64)) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2)
      ),
      SQRT(
        1 - (
          SIN((SAFE_CAST(st_end.latitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(st_start.latitude AS FLOAT64)) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2) * SIN((SAFE_CAST(st_end.latitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(st_start.latitude AS FLOAT64)) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2) +
          COS(SAFE_CAST(st_start.latitude AS FLOAT64) * ACOS(-1) / 180) * COS(SAFE_CAST(st_end.latitude AS FLOAT64) * ACOS(-1) / 180) *
          SIN((SAFE_CAST(st_end.longitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(st_start.longitude AS FLOAT64)) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2) * SIN((SAFE_CAST(st_end.longitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(st_start.longitude AS FLOAT64)) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2)
        )
      )
    )
  ) AS total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` st_start
  ON t.start_station_id = st_start.station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` st_end
  ON t.end_station_id = st_end.station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC

-- Full query with all components
WITH same_station AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    starttime,
    LAG(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as prev_start,
    LEAD(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as next_start
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(starttime, prev_start, SECOND) <= 120 THEN TRUE
      WHEN next_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(next_start, starttime, SECOND) <= 120 THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END as is_group
  FROM same_station
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNTIF(is_group) as group_trips
  FROM grouped
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
)
SELECT 
  g.end_station_id,
  s.name as station_name,
  g.group_trips,
  t.total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(g.group_trips, t.total_trips) as proportion
FROM group_counts g
JOIN total_counts t ON g.end_station_id = t.end_station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s ON CAST(g.end_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH all_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    total_amount,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01' 
    AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01' 
    AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    total_amount,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01' 
    AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01' 
    AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM all_trips
  WHERE passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND tip_amount >= 0
    AND tolls_amount >= 0
    AND mta_tax >= 0
    AND fare_amount >= 0
    AND total_amount >= 0
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT 
    pz.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
    dz.zone_name AS dropoff_zone,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(f.dropoff_datetime, f.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS trip_duration_seconds,
    f.trip_distance,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(f.trip_distance, SAFE_DIVIDE(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(f.dropoff_datetime, f.pickup_datetime, SECOND), 3600)) AS speed_mph,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(f.tip_amount, f.total_amount) * 100 AS tip_rate_pct,
    f.total_amount
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz ON f.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz ON f.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
)
SELECT 
  pickup_zone,
  dropoff_zone,
  trip_duration_seconds,
  speed_mph,
  tip_rate_pct
FROM enriched
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT
    t.pickup_datetime,
    t.dropoff_datetime,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    tz.borough AS pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE 
    t.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01')
    AND t.pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP('2016-01-08')
    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount > 0
),
with_tip_category AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_borough,
    CASE
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 5 THEN 'Less than 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 5 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 10 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 15 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 20 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 25 THEN 'More than 25%'
    END AS tip_category
  FROM filtered_trips
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_borough,
    tip_category,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM with_tip_category
  GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_borough,
    SUM(trip_count) AS total_trips
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY pickup_borough
)
SELECT
  c.pickup_borough,
  c.tip_category,
  c.trip_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(c.trip_count, t.total_trips) AS proportion
FROM counts c
JOIN totals t ON c.pickup_borough = t.pickup_borough
ORDER BY c.pickup_borough, c.tip_category

WITH users_2021 AS (
  SELECT 
    id as user_id,
    creation_date as signup_date,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM creation_date) as signup_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
first_questions AS (
  SELECT 
    owner_user_id,
    MIN(creation_date) as first_question_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  GROUP BY owner_user_id
),
users_with_first_q AS (
  SELECT 
    u.user_id,
    u.signup_date,
    u.signup_month,
    fq.first_question_date,
    CASE WHEN fq.first_question_date IS NOT NULL 
         AND fq.first_question_date >= u.signup_date
         AND fq.first_question_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.signup_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as asked_within_30_days
  FROM users_2021 u
  LEFT JOIN first_questions fq ON u.user_id = fq.owner_user_id
),
first_answers_after_first_q AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.owner_user_id,
    MIN(pa.creation_date) as first_answer_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  WHERE pa.creation_date > (
    SELECT MIN(fq2.creation_date)
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` fq2
    WHERE fq2.owner_user_id = pa.owner_user_id
  )
  GROUP BY pa.owner_user_id
)
SELECT 
  uq.signup_month,
  COUNT(*) as total_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(uq.asked_within_30_days) * 100.0, COUNT(*)) as pct_asked_within_30,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uq.asked_within_30_days = 1 AND fa.first_answer_date IS NOT NULL 
                         AND fa.first_answer_date > uq.first_question_date
                         AND fa.first_answer_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(uq.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
                      THEN uq.user_id END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uq.asked_within_30_days = 1 THEN uq.user_id END)
  ) * 100 as pct_answered_within_30_after_first
FROM users_with_first_q uq
LEFT JOIN first_answers_after_first_q fa ON uq.user_id = fa.owner_user_id
GROUP BY uq.signup_month
ORDER BY uq.signup_month

SELECT 
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(temp AS FLOAT64)), 1) AS avg_temp,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64)), 1) AS avg_wind_speed,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64)), 2) AS total_precip
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE stn = '725030' 
  AND wban = '14732'
  AND mo = '06' 
  AND da = '12'
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH wa_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE state = 'WA'
),
rainy_2023 AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.stn,
    gs.wban,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` gs
  INNER JOIN wa_stations ws ON gs.stn = ws.usaf AND gs.wban = ws.wban
  WHERE gs.prcp > 0 AND gs.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY gs.stn, gs.wban
),
rainy_2022 AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.stn,
    gs.wban,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` gs
  INNER JOIN wa_stations ws ON gs.stn = ws.usaf AND gs.wban = ws.wban
  WHERE gs.prcp > 0 AND gs.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY gs.stn, gs.wban
)
SELECT 
  r23.stn,
  r23.wban,
  ws.name,
  r23.rainy_days_2023,
  r22.rainy_days_2022,
  r23.rainy_days_2023 - r22.rainy_days_2022 AS difference
FROM rainy_2023 r23
JOIN rainy_2022 r22 ON r23.stn = r22.stn AND r23.wban = r22.wban
JOIN wa_stations ws ON r23.stn = ws.usaf AND r23.wban = ws.wban
WHERE r23.rainy_days_2023 > 150 AND r23.rainy_days_2023 < r22.rainy_days_2022
ORDER BY r23.rainy_days_2023 DESC

WITH annotations_set AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT case_barcode, category, classification
  FROM `isb-cgc.TCGA_bioclin_v0.Annotations`
  WHERE entity_type = 'Patient'
    AND (category = 'History of unacceptable prior treatment related to a prior/other malignancy' 
         OR classification = 'Redaction')
),
clinical_set AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT case_barcode
  FROM `isb-cgc.TCGA_bioclin_v0.Clinical`
  WHERE disease_code = 'BRCA'
    AND age_at_diagnosis <= 30
    AND gender = 'FEMALE'
),
full_joined AS (
  SELECT 
    a.case_barcode AS annotation_case_barcode,
    a.category AS cat_name,
    a.classification AS class_name,
    c.case_barcode AS clinical_case_barcode
  FROM annotations_set a
  FULL JOIN clinical_set c
    ON a.case_barcode = c.case_barcode
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  fj.clinical_case_barcode AS case_barcode,
  url.file_gdc_url
FROM full_joined fj
JOIN `isb-cgc.GDC_metadata.rel14_caseData` rcd
  ON rcd.case_barcode = fj.clinical_case_barcode
JOIN `isb-cgc.GDC_metadata.rel14_fileData_current` r14
  ON r14.case_gdc_id = rcd.case_gdc_id
JOIN `isb-cgc.GDC_metadata.rel14_GDCfileID_to_GCSurl_NEW` url
  ON url.file_gdc_id = r14.file_gdc_id
WHERE fj.cat_name IS NULL
  AND fj.class_name IS NULL
ORDER BY case_barcode, url.file_gdc_url

WITH temp_combined AS (
  SELECT 
    year, mo, da,
    CAST(AVG(temp) AS FLOAT64) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY year, mo, da
),
complaint_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT64) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY complaint_type, DATE(created_date)
),
total_complaints AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, CAST(SUM(daily_count) AS INT64) as total_count
  FROM complaint_daily
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(daily_count) > 5000
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(year, mo, da) as date_str, avg_temp
  FROM temp_combined
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    ad.date_str, 
    ad.avg_temp,
    tc.complaint_type, 
    tc.total_count,
    COALESCE(cd.daily_count, 0) as daily_count
  FROM all_dates ad
  CROSS JOIN total_complaints tc
  LEFT JOIN complaint_daily cd 
    ON ad.date_str = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', cd.complaint_date)
    AND cd.complaint_type = tc.complaint_type
),
with_pct AS (
  SELECT 
    date_str, 
    avg_temp, 
    complaint_type, 
    total_count, 
    daily_count,
    (daily_count * 100.0 / CAST(total_count AS FLOAT64)) as daily_pct
  FROM joined
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    total_count,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(avg_temp) as sum_x,
    SUM(daily_count) as sum_y_count,
    SUM(daily_pct) as sum_y_pct,
    SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) as sum_x2,
    SUM(daily_count * daily_count) as sum_y2_count,
    SUM(daily_pct * daily_pct) as sum_y2_pct,
    SUM(avg_temp * daily_count) as sum_xy_count,
    SUM(avg_temp * daily_pct) as sum_xy_pct
  FROM with_pct
  GROUP BY complaint_type, total_count
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_count,
  n,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy_count - sum_x * sum_y_count,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2_count - sum_y_count * sum_y_count))
  ), 4) as pearson_r_count,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy_pct - sum_x * sum_y_pct,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2_pct - sum_y_pct * sum_y_pct))
  ), 4) as pearson_r_pct
FROM stats
WHERE ABS(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy_count - sum_x * sum_y_count,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2_count - sum_y_count * sum_y_count))
  )) > 0.5
ORDER BY ABS(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy_count - sum_x * sum_y_count,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2_count - sum_y_count * sum_y_count))
  )) DESC

WITH wind AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(COALESCE(date, PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da))) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as complaint_date, COUNT(*) as total_daily
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2011-01-01' AND created_date < '2021-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as complaint_date, complaint_type, COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2011-01-01' AND created_date < '2021-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
type_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(type_count) as total_type_count
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING total_type_count > 3000
),
joined AS (
  SELECT w.weather_date, w.wind_speed, d.complaint_type, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(d.type_count, t.total_daily) as proportion
  FROM daily_complaints d
  JOIN daily_totals t ON d.complaint_date = t.complaint_date
  JOIN wind w ON d.complaint_date = w.weather_date
  WHERE w.wind_speed IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT j.complaint_type, tt.total_type_count,
  COUNT(*) as cnt,
  SUM(j.proportion) as sum_x,
  SUM(j.wind_speed) as sum_y,
  SUM(j.proportion * j.wind_speed) as sum_xy,
  SUM(j.proportion * j.proportion) as sum_x2,
  SUM(j.wind_speed * j.wind_speed) as sum_y2,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(*) * SUM(j.proportion * j.wind_speed) - SUM(j.proportion) * SUM(j.wind_speed),
    SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(j.proportion * j.proportion) - SUM(j.proportion) * SUM(j.proportion)) * (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.wind_speed * j.wind_speed) - SUM(j.wind_speed) * SUM(j.wind_speed)))
  ) as pearson_corr
FROM joined j
JOIN type_totals tt ON j.complaint_type = tt.complaint_type
GROUP BY j.complaint_type, tt.total_type_count
ORDER BY pearson_corr DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  month,

WITH weather AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    CASE WHEN value / 10.0 > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END as weather_condition
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025' 
    AND element = 'PRCP'
    AND qflag IS NULL
),
trips_per_day AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
    COUNT(*) as num_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE DATE(starttime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31'

)

WITH species_lookup AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(species_scientific_name) as species_upper,
    fall_color
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
),
count_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as species_upper,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE status != 'Dead'
    AND spc_latin NOT IN ('PLANTING SITE', 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES', 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES')
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
count_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as species_upper,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE status = 'Alive'
    AND spc_latin IS NOT NULL
    AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    sl.species_upper,
    sl.fall_color,
    COALESCE(c1995.cnt, 0) as trees_1995,
    COALESCE(c2015.cnt, 0) as trees_2015,
    COALESCE(c1995.cnt, 0) - COALESCE(c2015.cnt, 0) as diff
  FROM species_lookup sl
  LEFT JOIN count_1995 c1995 ON sl.species_upper = c1995.species_upper
  LEFT JOIN count_2015 c2015 ON sl.species_upper = c2015.species_upper
  WHERE COALESCE(c1995.cnt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(c2015.cnt, 0) > 0
)
SELECT 
  fall_color,
  SUM(diff) as total_change
FROM species_diff
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY fall_color

WITH y1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_1995,
    COUNTIF(status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Poor', 'Fair')) AS alive_1995,
    COUNTIF(status = 'Dead') AS dead_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
y2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total_2015,
    COUNTIF(status = 'Alive') AS alive_2015,
    COUNTIF(status = 'Dead') AS dead_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
),
y2015_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    latin_name,
    spc_common,
    total_2015,
    alive_2015,
    dead_2015
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      latin_name,
      spc_common,
      total_2015,
      alive_2015,
      dead_2015,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin_name ORDER BY total_2015 DESC) AS rn
    FROM y2015
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(y1995.latin_name, y2015_agg.latin_name) AS latin_name,
    COALESCE(y2015_agg.spc_common, 'N/A') AS common_name,
    COALESCE(y1995.total_1995, 0) AS total_1995,
    COALESCE(y2015_agg.total_2015, 0) AS total_2015,
    COALESCE(y1995.alive_1995, 0) AS alive_1995,
    COALESCE(y2015_agg.alive_2015, 0) AS alive_2015,
    COALESCE(y1995.dead_1995, 0) AS dead_1995,
    COALESCE(y2015_agg.dead_2015, 0) AS dead_2015,
    COALESCE(y2015_agg.total_2015, 0) - COALESCE(y1995.total_1995, 0) AS total_growth,
    COALESCE(y2015_agg.alive_2015, 0) - COALESCE(y1995.alive_1995, 0) AS alive_growth,
    COALESCE(y2015_agg.dead_2015, 0) - COALESCE(y1995.dead_1995, 0) AS dead_growth
  FROM y1995

-- Full query: proportional allocation and aggregation
WITH target_zips AS (
    SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` 
    WHERE zip_code IN ('98011', '98105', '98033', '98052', '98039', '98115', '98034', '98004')
),
tract_zip_overlap AS (
    SELECT 
        t.geo_id,
        z.zip_code,
        ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) as overlap_area,
        ST_AREA(t.tract_geom) as tract_area
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
    CROSS JOIN target_zips z
    WHERE ST_INTERSECTS(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
        AND ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) > 0
),
allocated AS (
    SELECT 
        tzo.zip_code,
        c.total_pop * (tzo.overlap_area / NULLIF(tzo.tract_area, 0)) as allocated_pop,
        c.total_pop * c.income_per_capita * (tzo.overlap_area / NULLIF(tzo.tract_area, 0)) as allocated_total_income
    FROM tract_zip_overlap tzo
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` c ON tzo.geo_id = c.geo_id
)
SELECT 
    zip_code,
    ROUND(SUM(allocated_pop), 0) as total_population,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(allocated_total_income), SUM(allocated_pop)), 1) as avg_individual_income
FROM allocated
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH natality AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) AS INT64) as birth_year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS as county_fips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_Desc = 'None checked' THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE Year IN ('2016-01-01', '2017-01-01', '2018-01-01')
    AND County_of_Residence_FIPS != '19999'
  GROUP BY birth_year, county_fips
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    n.birth_year,
    n.county_fips,
    c.poverty_rate,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(n.no_morbidity_births, n.total_births) * 100 as pct_no_morbidity
  FROM natality n
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT geo_id, poverty_rate, 2016 as census_year FROM census_2015
    UNION ALL SELECT geo_id, poverty_rate, 2017 FROM census_2016
    UNION ALL SELECT geo_id, poverty_rate, 2018 FROM census_2017
  ) c ON n.county_fips = c.geo_id AND n.birth_year = c.census_year
  WHERE c.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY birth_year
)
SELECT 
  birth_year,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_r
FROM agg
ORDER BY birth_year

-- Final query - full result
WITH person_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) as distinct_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as num_fatalities
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016`
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
),
accident_filter AS (
  SELECT state_number, consecutive_number
  FROM person_counts
  WHERE distinct_persons > 1
),
vehicle_info AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, body_type,
    travel_speed, speed_limit
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
),
first_vehicle AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, consecutive_number, body_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state_number, consecutive_number ORDER BY vehicle_number) as rn
  FROM vehicle_info
),
speed_data AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, consecutive_number,
    ABS(travel_speed - speed_limit) as speed_diff
  FROM vehicle_info
  WHERE travel_speed NOT IN (997, 998, 999)
    AND travel_speed >= 0
    AND speed_limit NOT IN (98, 99)
    AND speed_limit >= 0
),
accident_speed AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, consecutive_number,
    AVG(speed_diff) as avg_speed_diff
  FROM speed_data
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
)
SELECT 
  a.state_number,
  fv.body_type,
  a.number_of_drunk_drivers,
  a.day_of_week,
  a.hour_of_crash,
  CASE WHEN a.work_zone != 'None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as work_zone_binary,
  CASE 
    WHEN pc.num_fatalities > 1 THEN 1 
    ELSE 0 
  END as label,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(asp.avg_speed_diff, 0) < 20 THEN 0
    WHEN COALESCE(asp.avg_speed_diff, 0) < 40 THEN 1
    WHEN COALESCE(asp.avg_speed_diff, 0) < 60 THEN 2
    WHEN COALESCE(asp.avg_speed_diff, 0) < 80 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END as speed_diff_level
FROM accident_filter af
JOIN person_counts pc ON af.state_number = pc.state_number AND af.consecutive_number = pc.consecutive_number
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a 
  ON af.state_number = a.state_number AND af.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
JOIN first_vehicle fv ON af.state_number = fv.state_number AND af.consecutive_number = fv.consecutive_number AND fv.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN accident_speed asp ON af.state_number = asp.state_number AND af.consecutive_number = asp.consecutive_number

WITH latest_eval AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_sequence_number,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state_code ORDER BY evaluation_group DESC) as rn
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT state_code, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_sequence_number
        FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
        WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    )
),
filtered_pop AS (
    SELECT p.*
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    JOIN latest_eval le ON p.state_code = le.state_code 
        AND p.evaluation_group = le.evaluation_group
        AND p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = le.evaluation_group_sequence_number
    WHERE le.rn = 1
      AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.state_code,
        fp.evaluation_group,
        c.condition_status_code,
        c.reserved_status_code,
        c.site_productivity_class_code,
        c.proportion_basis,
        fp.expansion_factor,
        fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
        fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
        fp.expansion_factor * 
            CASE 
                WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 
                    THEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
                WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 
                    THEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
                ELSE 1
            END as adjusted_acres
    FROM filtered_pop fp
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON fp.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
),
timberland_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        evaluation_group,
        SUM(adjusted_acres) as total_acres
    FROM condition_acres
    WHERE condition_status_code = 1 
        AND reserved_status_code = 0 
        AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
    GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
),
forestland_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        evaluation_group,
        SUM(adjusted_acres) as total_acres
    FROM condition_acres
    WHERE condition_status_code = 1
    GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
),
timberland_best AS (
    SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, total_acres
    FROM timberland_acres
    ORDER BY total_acres DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
forestland_best AS (
    SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, total_acres
    FROM forestland_acres
    ORDER BY total_acres DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
state_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT 
    'timberland' as category,
    tb.state_code,
    tb.evaluation_group,
    sn.state_code_name,
    tb.total_acres
FROM timberland_best tb
JOIN state_names sn ON tb.state_code = sn.state_code

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'forestland' as category,

    fb.evaluation_group,
    sn.state_code_name,

FROM forestland_best fb
JOIN state_names sn ON fb.state_code = sn.state_code

small_contributions AS (

committee_totals AS (

JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_2016` cd ON cwc.cand_id = cd.cand_id

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_location_id,
    t.dropoff_location_id,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    tz.borough AS pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.data_file_month = 1
    AND t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
),
trip_flags AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_amount = 0 THEN 1
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_no_tip
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  SUM(is_no_tip) AS no_tip_count,
  COUNT(*) AS total_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(is_no_tip) * 100.0, COUNT(*)) AS no_tip_percentage
FROM trip_flags
GROUP BY pickup_borough
ORDER BY pickup_borough

SELECT DISTINCT t.start_position FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v2_1_1_exomes__chr17` AS t, UNNEST(t.alternate_bases) AS ab, UNNEST(ab.vep) AS v WHERE t.reference_name = '17' AND t.reference_bases = 'C' AND ab.alt = 'T' AND t.start_position BETWEEN 41196273 AND 41277388 AND v.SYMBOL = 'BRCA1' AND v.Consequence = 'missense_variant' ORDER BY t.start_position

WITH variant_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as num_variants,
    SUM(AN) as total_allele_count,
    SUM(
      (SELECT SUM(ab.AC) FROM UNNEST(t.alternate_bases) AS ab)
    ) as total_alt_allele_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1` AS t
  WHERE t.reference_name = 'chr1' 
    AND t.start_position >= 55039447 
    AND t.end_position <= 55064852
),
gene_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT vep_entry.SYMBOL) as distinct_genes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1` AS t,
    UNNEST(t.alternate_bases) AS ab,
    UNNEST(ab.vep) AS vep_entry
  WHERE t.reference_name = 'chr1' 
    AND t.start_position >= 55039447 
    AND t.end_position <= 55064852
    AND vep_entry.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  vs.num_variants,
  vs.total_alt_allele_count as total_allele_count,
  vs.total_allele_count as total_number_of_alleles,
  gs.distinct_genes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(55064852 - 55039447, vs.num_variants) as mutation_density
FROM variant_stats vs, gene_stats gs

WITH distraction_accidents_2015 AS (
    SELECT 
        a.state_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.consecutive_number) as distraction_accidents
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2015` d 
        ON a.state_number = d.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = d.consecutive_number
    WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
    GROUP BY a.state_name
),
distraction_accidents_2016 AS (
    SELECT 
        a.state_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.consecutive_number) as distraction_accidents
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2016` d 
        ON a.state_number = d.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = d.consecutive_number
    WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
    GROUP BY a.state_name
),
state_population AS (
    SELECT 
        za.state_name,
        SUM(p.population) as total_population
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
        ON p.zipcode = za.zipcode
    WHERE p.gender IS NULL AND p.minimum_age IS NULL
    GROUP BY za.state_name
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        '2015' as year,
        da.state_name,
        da.distraction_accidents,
        sp.total_population,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(da.distraction_accidents * 100000, sp.total_population) as rate_per_100k
    FROM distraction_accidents_2015 da
    JOIN state_population sp ON da.state_name = sp.state_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        '2016' as year,
        da.state_name,
        da.distraction_accidents,
        sp.total_population,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(da.distraction_accidents * 100000, sp.total_population) as rate_per_100k
    FROM distraction_accidents_2016 da
    JOIN state_population sp ON da.state_name = sp.state_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        state_name,
        distraction_accidents,
        total_population,
        ROUND(rate_per_100k, 2) as rate_per_100k,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY rate_per_100k DESC) as rn
    FROM combined
)
SELECT year, state_name, distraction_accidents, total_population, rate_per_100k, rn
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY year, rn

qualifying_accidents AS (

  UNION ALL SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q4` WHERE geoid = '42003'
),
wage_2017 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) as avg_wage

cpi_1998 AS (

WITH emp_2000 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) as avg_emp_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4')
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
emp_2018 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) as avg_emp_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4')
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
counts AS (
  SELECT county_fips_code, county_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '49'
)
SELECT 
  c.county_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(e2018.avg_emp_2018 - e2000.avg_emp_2000, e2000.avg_emp_2000) * 100, 2) as pct_increase

WITH epa AS (
  SELECT city_name, ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat, ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon, AVG(arithmetic_mean) as avg_pm25_1990
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.air_quality_annual_summary`
  WHERE parameter_name = 'Acceptable PM2.5 AQI & Speciation Mass' 
    AND units_of_measure = 'Micrograms/cubic meter (LC)' 
    AND year = 1990 
    AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY city_name, lat, lon
),
oaq AS (
  SELECT city, ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat, ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon, AVG(value) as avg_pm25_2020
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.openaq.global_air_quality`
  WHERE pollutant = 'pm25' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timestamp) = 2020 
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND value IS NOT NULL

  GROUP BY city, lat, lon
)
SELECT COALESCE(e.city_name, o.city) as city, e.lat, e.lon, e.avg_pm25_1990, o.avg_pm25_2020, 
       e.avg_pm25_1990 - o.avg_pm25_2020 as diff
FROM epa e

ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) as point_num
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND CAST(season AS STRING) = '2020' AND sid = '2020233N14313'
),
storm_distances AS (
  SELECT
    sp.sid,
    sp.name,
    sp.iso_time,
    sp.latitude,
    sp.longitude,
    sp.usa_wind,
    sp.point_num,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(sp.longitude, sp.latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(LEAD(sp.longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.sid ORDER BY sp.iso_time), 
                    LEAD(sp.latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.sid ORDER BY sp.iso_time))
    ) / 1000.0 as segment_distance_km
  FROM storm_points sp
)
SELECT 
  sid,
  name,
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  usa_wind,
  point_num,
  segment_distance_km,
  SUM(segment_distance_km) OVER (ORDER BY point_num) as cumulative_distance_km
FROM storm_distances
ORDER BY point_num

WITH snap_agg AS (

county_income AS (

)
SELECT 
  sa.FIPS,
  sa.geo_desc,
  sa.total_snap_households,
  ci.income_under_20k,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(ci.income_under_20k, sa.total_snap_households) as ratio

WITH question_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id AS question_id,
    q.creation_date AS question_date,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM q.creation_date) AS dow_num,
    FORMAT_DATE('%A', q.creation_date) AS day_name,
    (SELECT MIN(a.creation_date) 
     FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a 
     WHERE a.parent_id = q.id) AS earliest_answer_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
),
day_percentages AS (
  SELECT 
    day_name,
    dow_num,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN earliest_answer_date IS NOT NULL 
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(earliest_answer_date, question_date, SECOND) <= 3600 
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      COUNT(*)
    ) * 100 AS pct_within_1hr
  FROM question_answers
  GROUP BY dow_num, day_name
)
SELECT day_name, pct_within_1hr
FROM day_percentages
ORDER BY pct_within_1hr DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2

medication_counts AS (

WITH proteome_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        p.gene_symbol,
        a.sample_id,
        a.sample_submitter_id,
        a.sample_type,
        AVG(p.protein_abundance_log2ratio) as protein_abundance
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` a

      AND a.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    GROUP BY p.gene_symbol, a.sample_id, a.sample_submitter_id, a.sample_type
),
rna_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        r.gene_name,
        r.sample_barcode,
        r.sample_type_name,
        AVG(r.fpkm_unstranded) as avg_fpkm
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current` r
    WHERE r.primary_site = 'Kidney'
      AND r.sample_type_name IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    GROUP BY r.gene_name, r.sample_barcode, r.sample_type_name
),
joined AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.gene_symbol,
        pa.sample_type,
        pa.protein_abundance,
        LOG(rna.avg_fpkm + 1) as log_fpkm
    FROM proteome_agg pa
    JOIN rna_agg rna
      ON pa.sample_submitter_id = rna.sample_barcode
      AND pa.gene_symbol = rna.gene_name
      AND pa.sample_type = rna.sample_type_name
    WHERE pa.protein_abundance IS NOT NULL
      AND rna.avg_fpkm + 1 > 0
),
correlations AS (
    SELECT 
        sample_type,
        gene_symbol,
        CORR(protein_abundance, log_fpkm) as correlation
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY sample_type, gene_symbol
)
SELECT 
    sample_type,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(correlation) <= 0.5 THEN correlation END) as avg_correlation
FROM correlations
GROUP BY sample_type

-- Build 2x2 contingency table and calculate chi-squared statistic
WITH paad_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_barcode as patient_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
    WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
patient_mutations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.ParticipantBarcode as patient_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
    WHERE m.Study = 'PAAD' 
        AND m.Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')
    GROUP BY m.ParticipantBarcode
),
patient_status AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.patient_id,
        COALESCE(pm.has_kras, 0) as kras_present,
        COALESCE(pm.has_tp53, 0) as tp53_present
    FROM paad_patients pp
    LEFT JOIN patient_mutations pm ON pp.patient_id = pm.patient_id
),
contingency AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN kras_present = 1 AND tp53_present = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a,  -- both
        SUM(CASE WHEN kras_present = 1 AND tp53_present = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b,  -- KRAS only
        SUM(CASE WHEN kras_present = 0 AND tp53_present = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c,  -- TP53 only
        SUM(CASE WHEN kras_present = 0 AND tp53_present = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d,  -- neither
        COUNT(*) as total
    FROM patient_status
)
SELECT 
    a, b, c, d, total,
    -- Chi-squared statistic = N*(ad-bc)^2 / ((a+b)*(c+d)*(a+c)*(b+d))
    SAFE_DIVIDE(total * POWER(a*d - b*c, 2), 
        (a+b) * (c+d) * (a+c) * (b+d)) as chi_squared
FROM contingency

WITH kras_pass AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` 
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
tp53_pass AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` 
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
all_paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_barcode AS patient_id FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup` WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
both_mutated AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT k.ParticipantBarcode) as cnt
  FROM kras_pass k INNER JOIN tp53_pass t ON k.ParticipantBarcode = t.ParticipantBarcode
),
neither_mutated AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) as cnt
  FROM all_paad_patients p
  WHERE p.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT ParticipantBarcode FROM kras_pass)
    AND p.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT ParticipantBarcode FROM tp53_pass)
)
SELECT (SELECT cnt FROM both_mutated) - (SELECT cnt FROM neither_mutated) AS net_difference

-- Build the complete query to find imaging assay types at WUSTL with their available levels
WITH wustl_level2 AS (
    -- Get WUSTL Level2 imaging assay types
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        img.Imaging_Assay_Type,
        img.entityId,
        img.HTAN_Data_File_ID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.imaging_level2_metadata_r5` img
    WHERE img.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL'
    AND img.Component IS NOT NULL
    AND img.Component NOT LIKE '%Auxiliary%'
    AND img.Component NOT LIKE '%OtherAssay%'
),
-- Check for Level3 derived from WUSTL Level2 via id_provenance_r5
level3_exists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l3.HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` l3
    WHERE l3.Component = 'ImagingLevel3Segmentation'
    AND l3.HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID IN (SELECT HTAN_Data_File_ID FROM wustl_level2)
),
-- Check for Level4 derived from WUSTL Level2 via id_provenance_r5
level4_exists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l4.HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` l4
    WHERE l4.Component = 'ImagingLevel4'
    AND l4.HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID IN (SELECT HTAN_Data_File_ID FROM wustl_level2)
),
-- Get available levels for each assay type (distinct)
wustl_assay_levels AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        w.Imaging_Assay_Type,
        'Level2' AS data_level
    FROM wustl_level2 w
    WHERE w.Imaging_Assay_Type NOT LIKE '%Electron Microscopy%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT w.Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level3' AS data_level
    FROM wustl_level2 w
    INNER JOIN level3_exists l3 ON w.HTAN_Data_File_ID = l3.HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID
    WHERE w.Imaging_Assay_Type NOT LIKE '%Electron Microscopy%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT w.Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level4' AS data_level
    FROM wustl_level2 w
    INNER JOIN level4_exists l4 ON w.HTAN_Data_File_ID = l4.HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID
    WHERE w.Imaging_Assay_Type NOT LIKE '%Electron Microscopy%'
)
SELECT 
    Imaging_Assay_Type,
    STRING_AGG(data_level, ', ' ORDER BY data_level) AS available_levels
FROM wustl_assay_levels
GROUP BY Imaging_Assay_Type
ORDER BY Imaging_Assay_Type

WITH valid_samples AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.RefNo, cc.CaseNo, cc.InvNo, cc.Clone
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` cy ON cc.RefNo = cy.RefNo AND cc.CaseNo = cy.CaseNo
  WHERE cy.Morph = '3111' AND cy.Topo = '0401'
),
total_samples AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM valid_samples
),
band_gains AS (
  SELECT 
    cb.cytoband_name,
    cb.hg38_start,
    cb.hg38_stop,
    cc.ChrOrd,
    COUNT(DISTINCT vs.RefNo || '|' || vs.CaseNo || '|' || vs.InvNo || '|' || vs.Clone) as gain_count
  FROM valid_samples vs
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc ON vs.RefNo = cc.RefNo AND vs.CaseNo = cc.CaseNo AND vs.InvNo = cc.InvNo AND vs.Clone = cc.Clone
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb ON cc.Chr = cb.Chromosome 
    AND cc.Start >= cb.hg38_start 
    AND cc.`End` <= cb.hg38_stop
  WHERE cc.Type = 'Gain'
  GROUP BY cb.cytoband_name, cb.hg38_start, cb.hg38_stop, cc.ChrOrd
),
band_losses AS (
  SELECT 
    cb.cytoband_name,
    cb.hg38_start,
    cb.hg38_stop,
    cc.ChrOrd,
    COUNT(DISTINCT vs.RefNo || '|' || vs.CaseNo || '|' || vs.InvNo || '|' || vs.Clone) as loss_count
  FROM valid_samples vs
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc ON vs.RefNo = cc.RefNo AND vs.CaseNo = cc.CaseNo AND vs.InvNo = cc.InvNo AND vs.Clone = cc.Clone
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb ON cc.Chr = cb.Chromosome 
    AND cc.Start >= cb.hg38_start 
    AND cc.`End` <= cb.hg38_stop
  WHERE cc.Type = 'Loss'
  GROUP BY cb.cytoband_name, cb.hg38_start, cb.hg38_stop, cc.ChrOrd
),
all_bands AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(bg.cytoband_name, bl.cytoband_name) as cytoband_name,
    COALESCE(bg.hg38_start, bl.hg38_start) as hg38_start,
    COALESCE(bg.hg38_stop, bl.hg38_stop) as hg38_stop,
    COALESCE(bg.ChrOrd, bl.ChrOrd) as ChrOrd,
    COALESCE(bg.gain_count, 0) as gains,
    COALESCE(bl.loss_count, 0) as losses
  FROM band_gains bg
  FULL OUTER JOIN band_losses bl ON bg.cytoband_name = bl.cytoband_name AND bg.hg38_start = bl.hg38_start AND bg.hg38_stop = bl.hg38_stop AND bg.ChrOrd = bl.ChrOrd
)
SELECT 
  ab.cytoband_name,
  ab.hg38_start,
  ab.hg38_stop,
  0 as amplifications,
  ab.gains,
  ab.losses,
  0 as homozygous_deletions
FROM all_bands ab
ORDER BY ab.ChrOrd, ab.hg38_start

WITH chr13_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` 
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' 
    AND Start < 48481890 AND `End` > 48303751
),
chr17_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` 
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' 
    AND Start < 7687490 AND `End` > 7668421
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` 
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' 
    AND Start < 108369102 AND `End` > 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  JOIN chr17_loss c17 ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  JOIN chr11_gain c11 ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone
)
SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
       c13.ChrOrd as chr13_ChromOrd, c13.Start as chr13_Start, c13.`End` as chr13_End,
       c17.ChrOrd as chr17_ChromOrd, c17.Start as chr17_Start, c17.`End` as chr17_End,
       c11.ChrOrd as chr11_ChromOrd, c11.Start as chr11_Start, c11.`End` as chr11_End,
       kc.CloneShort
FROM matching_clones mc
JOIN chr13_loss c13 ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone AND c13.rn = 1
JOIN chr17_loss c17 ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone AND c17.rn = 1
JOIN chr11_gain c11 ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone AND c11.rn = 1
JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone

-- Now compute: for each station, the percentage of valid days, and flag those >= 90%
WITH station_data AS (
    SELECT stn, 
           COUNT(*) AS total_days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                    AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                    AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_days,
           SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                    AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                    AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*)) AS valid_pct
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
    WHERE year = '2022' AND stn != '999999'
    GROUP BY stn
),
qualified_stations AS (
    SELECT stn, valid_pct
    FROM station_data
    WHERE valid_pct >= 0.90
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS stations_with_90pct,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stn) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` WHERE year = '2022' AND stn != '999999') AS total_stations,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stn) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` WHERE year = '2022' AND stn != '999999')) * 100 AS percentage
FROM qualified_stations

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as cnt,
  AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, MINUTE)) as avg_minutes
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` yt
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz 
  ON yt.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz 
  ON yt.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
WHERE yt.data_file_year = 2016 
  AND yt.data_file_month = 2
  AND DATE(yt.pickup_datetime) >= '2016-02-01'
  AND DATE(yt.pickup_datetime) <= '2016-02-07'
  AND (dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime)
  AND yt.passenger_count > 3
  AND yt.trip_distance >= 10
  AND pz.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND dz.borough = 'Brooklyn'

WITH first_last AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(start_date, MONTH) as year_month,
    duration_sec,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC(start_date, MONTH) ORDER BY start_date ASC) as rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC(start_date, MONTH) ORDER BY start_date DESC) as rn_desc,
    MIN(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC(start_date, MONTH)) as min_sec,
    MAX(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC(start_date, MONTH)) as max_sec
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', year_month) as year_month,
  SAFE_CAST(MIN(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_sec END) AS FLOAT64) / 60.0 as first_duration_min,
  SAFE_CAST(MIN(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_sec END) AS FLOAT64) / 60.0 as last_duration_min,
  SAFE_CAST(MAX(max_sec) AS FLOAT64) / 60.0 as highest_duration_min,
  SAFE_CAST(MAX(min_sec) AS FLOAT64) / 60.0 as lowest_duration_min
FROM first_last
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month

WITH season_max AS (

peak_teams AS (

-- Final query with just the required columns
WITH unique_plots AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pt.plot_sequence_number,
        pt.plot_inventory_year,
        pt.plot_state_code
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` pt
    WHERE pt.plot_inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
),
subplot_plot_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        c.plot_sequence_number,
        c.inventory_year,
        c.state_code,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot),
            COUNT(*)) as plot_avg_size
    FROM unique_plots up
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
        ON up.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
        AND up.plot_inventory_year = c.inventory_year
        AND up.plot_state_code = c.state_code
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
        ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
        AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
        AND c.state_code = p.state_code
        AND c.survey_unit_code = p.survey_unit_code
        AND c.county_code = p.county_code
        AND c.phase_2_plot_number = p.phase_2_plot_number
    WHERE c.condition_status_code = 1
        AND c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP'
        AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
        AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0
    GROUP BY c.plot_sequence_number, c.inventory_year, c.state_code
),
subplot_state_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        inventory_year,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(plot_avg_size), COUNT(*)) as avg_size
    FROM subplot_plot_avg
    GROUP BY state_code, inventory_year
),
macroplot_plot_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        c.plot_sequence_number,
        c.inventory_year,
        c.state_code,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot),
            COUNT(*)) as plot_avg_size
    FROM unique_plots up
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
        ON up.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
        AND up.plot_inventory_year = c.inventory_year
        AND up.plot_state_code = c.state_code
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
        ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
        AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
        AND c.state_code = p.state_code
        AND c.survey_unit_code = p.survey_unit_code
        AND c.county_code = p.county_code
        AND c.phase_2_plot_number = p.phase_2_plot_number
    WHERE c.condition_status_code = 1
        AND c.proportion_basis = 'MACR'
        AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
        AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0
    GROUP BY c.plot_sequence_number, c.inventory_year, c.state_code
),
macroplot_state_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        inventory_year,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(plot_avg_size), COUNT(*)) as avg_size
    FROM macroplot_plot_avg
    GROUP BY state_code, inventory_year
),
subplot_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        inventory_year,
        'subplot' as plot_type,
        avg_size
    FROM subplot_state_avg
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_size DESC) = 1
),
macroplot_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        inventory_year,
        'macroplot' as plot_type,
        avg_size
    FROM macroplot_state_avg
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_size DESC) = 1
)
SELECT state_code, inventory_year, plot_type, avg_size
FROM subplot_ranked
UNION ALL
SELECT state_code, inventory_year, plot_type, avg_size
FROM macroplot_ranked
ORDER BY plot_type, inventory_year

),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,

    MAX(date) AS last_visit_date,
    MIN(IF(has_trans, date, NULL)) AS first_transaction_date
  FROM base
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
max_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM base
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
min_trans_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS min_trans_date
  FROM base
  WHERE has_trans = TRUE
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
last_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    b.fullVisitorId,
    b.isMobile AS last_visit_is_mobile
  FROM base b
  JOIN max_dates m ON b.fullVisitorId = m.fullVisitorId AND b.date = m.max_date
),
first_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    b.fullVisitorId,
    b.isMobile AS first_transaction_is_mobile
  FROM base b
  JOIN min_trans_dates m ON b.fullVisitorId = m.fullVisitorId AND b.date = m.min_trans_date
)
SELECT 
  a.fullVisitorId,
  a.first_visit_date,
  a.last_visit_date,
  a.first_transaction_date,
  l.last_visit_is_mobile,
  f.first_transaction_is_mobile
FROM agg a
JOIN last_visit l ON a.fullVisitorId = l.fullVisitorId
LEFT JOIN first_trans f ON a.fullVisitorId = f.fullVisitorId

WITH first_visit AS (

  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitStartTime,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date, visitStartTime) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL

),
first_txn_session AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,

)

  WHERE state_name IN ('Alabama','Alaska','Arizona','Arkansas','California','Colorado','Connecticut','Delaware','District of Columbia','Florida','Georgia','Hawaii','Idaho','Illinois','Indiana','Iowa','Kansas','Kentucky','Louisiana','Maine','Maryland','Massachusetts','Michigan','Minnesota','Mississippi','Missouri','Montana','Nebraska','Nevada','New Hampshire','New Jersey','New Mexico','New York','North Carolina','North Dakota','Ohio','Oklahoma','Oregon','Pennsylvania','Rhode Island','South Carolina','South Dakota','Tennessee','Texas','Utah','Vermont','Virginia','Washington','West Virginia','Wisconsin','Wyoming')

WITH filtered AS (

    g.date,

    g.min,
