  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s 
    ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE g.mo = '10' AND g.da BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
    AND s.country IN ('US', 'UK')
    AND g.temp != 9999.9
    AND g.max != 9999.9
    AND g.min != 9999.9
),
country_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    country,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp,
    AVG(max) as avg_max,
    AVG(min) as avg_min
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY date, country
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_temp END) as us_avg_temp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_max END) as us_avg_max,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_min END) as us_avg_min,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_temp END) as uk_avg_temp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_max END) as uk_avg_max,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_min END) as uk_avg_min
  FROM country_daily
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT 
  date,
  ROUND(us_avg_max - uk_avg_max, 1) as max_temp_diff,
  ROUND(us_avg_min - uk_avg_min, 1) as min_temp_diff,
  ROUND(us_avg_temp - uk_avg_temp, 1) as avg_temp_diff
FROM pivot
ORDER BY date

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    t.pickup_datetime,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour,
    DATE(t.pickup_datetime) as trip_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude), z.zip_code_geom)
  WHERE t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
),
zip_hour_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    hour,
    trip_date,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour, trip_date
),
ny_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` 
  WHERE state_name = 'New York'
),
all_hours AS (
  SELECT 0 as hour UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
  UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
  UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
  UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
),
cross_join AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM ny_zips z
  CROSS JOIN all_hours h
),
base AS (
  SELECT 
    cj.zip_code,
    cj.hour,
    COALESCE(zhc.cnt, 0) as trip_count
  FROM cross_join cj
  LEFT JOIN zip_hour_counts zhc 
    ON cj.zip_code = zhc.zip_code 
    AND cj.hour = zhc.hour
    AND zhc.trip_date = '2015-01-01'
),
lookback_14 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour,
    b.trip_count,
    COALESCE((SELECT zhc.cnt FROM zip_hour_counts zhc 
              WHERE zhc.zip_code = b.zip_code AND zhc.hour = b.hour AND zhc.trip_date = '2014-12-31'), 0) as trips_1hr_ago,
    COALESCE((SELECT zhc.cnt FROM zip_hour_counts zhc 
              WHERE zhc.zip_code = b.zip_code AND zhc.hour = b.hour AND zhc.trip_date = '2014-12-31'), 0) as trips_1day_ago,
    COALESCE((SELECT zhc.cnt FROM zip_hour_counts zhc 
              WHERE zhc.zip_code = b.zip_code AND zhc.hour = b.hour AND zhc.trip_date = '2014-12-25'), 0) as trips_7day_ago,
    COALESCE((SELECT zhc.cnt FROM zip_hour_counts zhc 
              WHERE zhc.zip_code = b.zip_code AND zhc.hour = b.hour AND zhc.trip_date = '2014-12-18'), 0) as trips_14day_ago,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(COALESCE(zhc.cnt, 0)),
      COUNT(zhc.trip_date)
    ) as moving_avg_14day,
    STDDEV(COALESCE(zhc.cnt, 0)) as stddev_14day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN zip_hour_counts zhc 
    ON b.zip_code = zhc.zip_code 
    AND zhc.trip_date BETWEEN '2014-12-18' AND '2014-12-31'
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour, b.trip_count
),
lookback_21 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(COALESCE(zhc.cnt, 0)),
      COUNT(zhc.trip_date)
    ) as moving_avg_21day,
    STDDEV(COALESCE(zhc.cnt, 0)) as stddev_21day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN zip_hour_counts zhc 
    ON b.zip_code = zhc.zip_code 
    AND zhc.trip_date BETWEEN '2014-12-11' AND '2014-12-31'
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour
)
SELECT 
  l.zip_code,
  l.hour,
  l.trip_count,
  l.trips_1hr_ago,
  l.trips_1day_ago,
  l.trips_7day_ago,
  l.trips_14day_ago,
  l.moving_avg_14day,
  l.stddev_14day,
  l2.moving_avg_21day,
  l2.stddev_21day
FROM lookback_14 l
LEFT JOIN lookback_21 l2
  ON l.zip_code = l2.zip_code AND l.hour = l2.hour
ORDER BY l.trip_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT tag, id, title, view_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`, UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) as tag WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%how%' AND tag IN ('android-layout', 'android-activity', 'android-intent', 'android-edittext', 'android-fragments', 'android-recyclerview', 'listview', 'android-actionbar', 'google-maps', 'android-asynctask') AND NOT (LOWER(title) LIKE '%fail%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%problem%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%wrong%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%fix%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%bug%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%issue%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%solve%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%trouble%') QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tag ORDER BY view_count DESC) <= 50 ORDER BY tag, view_count DESC

WITH question_owners AS (
  SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  WHERE q.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),
accepted_answer_users AS (
  SELECT q.id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.accepted_answer_id = a.id
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
),
high_score_answers AS (
  SELECT q.id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.id = a.parent_id
  WHERE a.score > 5
),
question_total_scores AS (
  SELECT parent_id, SUM(score) AS total_score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
),
percentile_answers AS (
  SELECT q.id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.id = a.parent_id
  JOIN question_total_scores qts ON q.id = qts.parent_id
  WHERE a.score > 0 AND a.score > 0.2 * qts.total_score
),
top3_answers AS (
  SELECT q.id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN (
    SELECT parent_id, owner_user_id, score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY score DESC) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  ) a ON q.id = a.parent_id
  WHERE a.rn <= 3
),
all_associated AS (
  SELECT question_id, user_id, view_count FROM question_owners
  UNION ALL
  SELECT question_id, user_id, view_count FROM accepted_answer_users
  UNION ALL
  SELECT question_id, user_id, view_count FROM high_score_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT question_id, user_id, view_count FROM percentile_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT question_id, user_id, view_count FROM top3_answers
),
distinct_pairs AS (
  SELECT question_id, user_id, view_count
  FROM all_associated
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY question_id, user_id, view_count
)
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.display_name, SUM(dp.view_count) AS total_view_count
FROM distinct_pairs dp
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON dp.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.display_name
ORDER BY total_view_count DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH answers AS (

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE a.owner_user_id = 1908967 
    AND a.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
),
tags_exploded AS (
  SELECT answer_id, parent_id, tag, creation_date
  FROM answers, UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) AS tag
),
vote_counts AS (
  SELECT post_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as upvote_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accepted_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes`
  WHERE vote_type_id IN (1, 2)
  GROUP BY post_id
)
SELECT te.tag, 
       SUM(10 * COALESCE(vc.upvote_count, 0) + 15 * COALESCE(vc.accepted_count, 0)) as total_score

WITH questions_2021 AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    creation_date,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM creation_date) AS dow,
    FORMAT_DATE('%A', creation_date) AS day_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
earliest_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    parent_id AS question_id,
    MIN(creation_date) AS earliest_answer_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
)
SELECT 
  q.dow,
  q.day_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_questions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ea.earliest_answer_date IS NOT NULL 
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(ea.earliest_answer_date, q.creation_date, SECOND) <= 3600 
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answered_within_1hr,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN ea.earliest_answer_date IS NOT NULL 
             AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(ea.earliest_answer_date, q.creation_date, SECOND) <= 3600 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 AS pct_answered_within_1hr
FROM questions_2021 q
LEFT JOIN earliest_answers ea ON ea.question_id = q.id
GROUP BY q.dow, q.day_name
ORDER BY q.dow

WITH qualifying_questions AS (
  SELECT q.id, q.body, q.owner_user_id, q.view_count, q.accepted_answer_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT q.id, q.body, q.owner_user_id, q.view_count, q.accepted_answer_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.id = a.parent_id
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(a.score AS FLOAT64), CAST(q.view_count AS FLOAT64)) > 0.01
),
user_badges AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as badge_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.badges`
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT 
  qq.id as question_id,
  LENGTH(qq.body) as body_length,
  u.reputation,
  u.up_votes - u.down_votes as net_votes,
  COALESCE(ub.badge_count, 0) as total_badges
FROM qualifying_questions qq
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON qq.owner_user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN user_badges ub ON qq.owner_user_id = ub.user_id
ORDER BY body_length DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH pop_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    CAST(year_2017 AS FLOAT64) AS pop_2017,
    CAST(year_2018 AS FLOAT64) AS pop_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2017 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 IS NOT NULL
),
health_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END) AS health_2017,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN value END) AS health_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY country_code
),
countries AS (
  SELECT country_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.country_summary`
  WHERE special_notes IS NULL OR special_notes = ''
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM pop_data p
JOIN health_data h ON p.country_code = h.country_code
JOIN countries c ON p.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(p.pop_2018 - p.pop_2017, p.pop_2017) > 0.01
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(h.health_2018 - h.health_2017, h.health_2017) > 0.01

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT indicator_code) AS debt_indicator_count_zero

WITH latest_gdp AS (
  SELECT cs.country_code, cs.region, id.value as gdp_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.country_summary` cs
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` id
    ON cs.country_code = id.country_code
  WHERE id.indicator_code = 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD'
    AND id.value IS NOT NULL
    AND id.year = 2020
    AND cs.region IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.region != ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region, gdp_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY gdp_value) as rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY region) as cnt
  FROM latest_gdp
)
SELECT region, AVG(gdp_value) as median_gdp
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY median_gdp DESC

SELECT 
  z.zip_code,
  b.geo_id,
  ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)) as intersection_area,
  ST_AREA(b.blockgroup_geom) as bg_area,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)), ST_AREA(b.blockgroup_geom)) as overlap_ratio
FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
CROSS JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.blockgroups_08` b
WHERE z.state_fips_code = '08'
  AND b.state_fips_code = '08'
  AND ST_INTERSECTS(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)
LIMIT 5

WITH tract_data AS (
  SELECT 
    a.geo_id,
    a.total_pop AS pop_2011,
    b.total_pop AS pop_2018,
    a.median_income AS income_2011,
    b.median_income AS income_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(b.total_pop - a.total_pop, a.total_pop) * 100 AS pop_pct_increase,
    b.median_income - a.median_income AS income_abs_increase
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` b 
    ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
  WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '36047%' 
    AND a.total_pop > 1000 
    AND b.total_pop > 1000
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    pop_2011,
    pop_2018,
    income_2011,
    income_2018,
    pop_pct_increase,
    income_abs_increase,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_increase DESC) AS pop_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_increase DESC) AS income_rank
  FROM tract_data
)
SELECT 
  geo_id,
  pop_2011,
  pop_2018,
  pop_pct_increase,
  income_2011,
  income_2018,
  income_abs_increase,
  pop_rank,
  income_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE pop_rank <= 20 AND income_rank <= 20
ORDER BY pop_rank

WITH monthly_usage AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM end_date) AS month_num,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 60000.0 AS total_minutes_thousands
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_date) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Subscriber', 'Customer')
  GROUP BY month_num, subscriber_type
)
SELECT
  month_num,
  MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE NULL END) AS subscriber_minutes,
  MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE NULL END) AS customer_minutes,
  ABS(
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE NULL END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE NULL END)
  ) AS abs_diff_thousands
FROM monthly_usage
GROUP BY month_num
ORDER BY abs_diff_thousands DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT

FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality` n

WHERE c.geo_id LIKE '55%'

SELECT 
  c.concept_code,
  c.concept_name,
  pc.participant_count,
  t.total,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(pc.participant_count * 100.0, t.total), 2) as percentage
FROM (
  SELECT sm.standard_concept_id, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) as participant_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co
  JOIN (
    WITH subsumes AS (
      SELECT concept_id_1 as ancestor_id, concept_id_2 as descendant_id
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
      WHERE relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
    ),
    level1 AS (
      SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id
      FROM subsumes
      WHERE ancestor_id IN (1569798, 1569765, 1569777, 35208655)
    ),
    level2 AS (
      SELECT l1.ancestor_id, s.descendant_id
      FROM level1 l1
      JOIN subsumes s ON l1.descendant_id = s.ancestor_id
    ),
    level3 AS (
      SELECT l2.ancestor_id, s.descendant_id
      FROM level2 l2
      JOIN subsumes s ON l2.descendant_id = s.ancestor_id
    ),
    level4 AS (
      SELECT l3.ancestor_id, s.descendant_id
      FROM level3 l3
      JOIN subsumes s ON l3.descendant_id = s.ancestor_id
    ),
    all_desc AS (
      SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM level1
      UNION ALL
      SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM level2
      UNION ALL
      SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM level3
      UNION ALL
      SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM level4
    ),
    icd10_hierarchies AS (
      SELECT ancestor_id as standard_concept_id, descendant_id as icd10_concept_id
      FROM all_desc
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 1569798, 1569798
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 1569765, 1569765
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 1569777, 1569777
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 35208655, 35208655
    ),
    snomed_map AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT ih.standard_concept_id, cr.concept_id_2 as snomed_concept_id
      FROM icd10_hierarchies ih
      JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr 
        ON ih.icd10_concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
      WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
    )
    SELECT * FROM snomed_map
  ) sm ON co.condition_concept_id = sm.snomed_concept_id
  GROUP BY sm.standard_concept_id
) pc
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` c ON pc.standard_concept_id = c.concept_id
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as total FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) t
WHERE c.concept_id IN (1569798, 1569765, 1569777, 35208655)
ORDER BY c.concept_code

SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) 
    - 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) 
     FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
     JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength` ds 
       ON de.drug_concept_id = ds.drug_concept_id
     WHERE ds.ingredient_concept_id = 1331235
    ),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`)
  ) * 100 AS percentage_not_using_quinapril

-- Build the full query:
-- 1. Get valid days per station in 2019
-- 2. Join with stations table to filter by period of record
-- 3. Check if valid_days >= 90% of 365 = 328.5 -> round up to 329

WITH valid_days AS (
  SELECT stn, COUNT(*) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn != '999999' 
    AND temp != 9999.9 AND max != 9999.9 AND min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY stn
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as count_stations_90pct
FROM valid_days vd
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s 
  ON vd.stn = s.usaf
WHERE s.begin <= '20000101' 
  AND s.`end` >= '20190630'
  AND vd.valid_days >= 0.9 * 365

SELECT 
  latitude, 
  longitude, 
  CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', 
    LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', 
    LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING), 2, '0')) AS date,
  AVG(wind_speed) AS avg_wind_speed
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2005' AND '2015'
  AND wind_speed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY latitude, longitude, year, month, day
ORDER BY avg_wind_speed DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH mountain_view_providers AS (

unpivoted AS (

  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, spec3 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec3 IS NOT NULL AND spec3 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, spec4 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec4 IS NOT NULL AND spec4 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, spec5 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec5 IS NOT NULL AND spec5 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, spec6 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec6 IS NOT NULL AND spec6 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, spec7 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec7 IS NOT NULL AND spec7 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, spec8 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec8 IS NOT NULL AND spec8 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, spec9 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec9 IS NOT NULL AND spec9 != ''
  UNION ALL

  UNION ALL

  UNION ALL

specialization_counts AS (

top10 AS (

  ABS(t.distinct_npi_count - a.avg_npi_count) AS diff_from_avg

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    DATE_TRUNC(trip_start_timestamp, MONTH) AS trip_month,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE company IS NOT NULL AND company != ''
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trip_start_timestamp) = 2018
  GROUP BY company, trip_month
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    trip_month,
    trip_count,
    LAG(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY trip_month) AS prev_month_count
  FROM monthly_counts
)
SELECT 
  company,
  trip_month,
  trip_count - prev_month_count AS increase
FROM with_prev
WHERE prev_month_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH distinct_minutes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT SAFE_CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) AS trip_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
),
minute_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_minutes,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY trip_minutes) AS quantile_group
  FROM distinct_minutes
),
trip_with_group AS (
  SELECT 
    SAFE_CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) AS trip_minutes,
    t.fare,
    mg.quantile_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips` t
  JOIN minute_groups mg ON SAFE_CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) = mg.trip_minutes
  WHERE t.trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(MIN(trip_minutes) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm to ', LPAD(CAST(MAX(trip_minutes) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm') AS time_range,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(fare), COUNT(*)), 2) AS average_fare
FROM trip_with_group
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY MIN(trip_minutes)

WITH label_counts AS (
  SELECT o.period, la.description AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT o.object_id) AS artwork_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.the_met.objects` o
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.the_met.vision_api_data` v ON o.object_id = v.object_id
  JOIN UNNEST(v.labelAnnotations) la
  WHERE o.period IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.period, la.description
  HAVING artwork_count >= 500
)
SELECT period, label, artwork_count,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY artwork_count DESC) as rn
FROM label_counts
QUALIFY rn <= 3
ORDER BY period, rn

WITH new_users AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitStartTime AS initial_visitStartTime,
    totals.timeOnSite
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
    AND visitNumber = 1
),
long_initial_users AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, initial_visitStartTime
  FROM new_users
  WHERE timeOnSite > 300
),
purchaser_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId, visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
),
qualified_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.fullVisitorId
  FROM long_initial_users l
  JOIN purchaser_sessions p
    ON l.fullVisitorId = p.fullVisitorId
    AND p.visitStartTime > l.initial_visitStartTime
),
total_new_users AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId) as total_count
  FROM new_users
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId) FROM qualified_users) * 100.0 / 
  (SELECT total_count FROM total_new_users), 2
) as percentage

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as station_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, s.station_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
),
incident_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as incident_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` i
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(i.longitude, i.latitude))
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
)
SELECT sc.neighborhood, sc.station_count, ic.incident_count
FROM station_counts sc
JOIN incident_counts ic
ON sc.neighborhood = ic.neighborhood
ORDER BY sc.neighborhood

-- Get highest precipitation (PRCP), minimum temperature (TMIN), and maximum temperature (TMAX)
-- for the last 15 days (Dec 17-31) of each year 2013-2016 for station USW00094846
-- GHCN values are in tenths, so divide by 10 for mm and degrees Celsius
WITH yearly_data AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year,
    element,
    value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2013`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND date >= '2013-12-17' AND date <= '2013-12-31'
    AND qflag IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year,
    element,
    value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2014`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND date >= '2014-12-17' AND date <= '2014-12-31'
    AND qflag IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year,
    element,
    value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2015`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND date >= '2015-12-17' AND date <= '2015-12-31'
    AND qflag IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year,
    element,
    value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND date >= '2016-12-17' AND date <= '2016-12-31'
    AND qflag IS NULL
)
SELECT 
  year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10.0) END) as highest_precipitation_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10.0) END) as min_temperature_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10.0) END) as max_temperature_c
FROM yearly_data
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH pm10 AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS pm10_avg
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm10_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
pm25_frm AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS pm25_frm_avg
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_frm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
pm25_nonfrm AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS pm25_nonfrm_avg
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_nonfrm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
voc AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS voc_avg
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.voc_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
so2 AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 10 AS so2_avg
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.so2_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
lead AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 100 AS lead_avg
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.lead_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', p.month) AS month,
  ROUND(p.pm10_avg, 2) AS pm10_avg,
  ROUND(pr.pm25_frm_avg, 2) AS pm25_frm_avg,
  ROUND(pn.pm25_nonfrm_avg, 2) AS pm25_nonfrm_avg,
  ROUND(v.voc_avg, 2) AS voc_avg,
  ROUND(s.so2_avg, 2) AS so2_avg,
  ROUND(l.lead_avg, 2) AS lead_avg
FROM pm10 p
JOIN pm25_frm pr ON p.month = pr.month
JOIN pm25_nonfrm pn ON p.month = pn.month
JOIN voc v ON p.month = v.month
JOIN so2 s ON p.month = s.month
JOIN lead l ON p.month = l.month
ORDER BY p.month

-- For each condition, find the max number of distinct active meds any single patient has
WITH living_patients AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient`
  WHERE (deceased.boolean IS NULL OR deceased.boolean = FALSE)
    AND name[OFFSET(0)].family LIKE 'A%'
),
patient_condition_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.subject.patientId,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as num_distinct_conditions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.subject.patientId IN (SELECT id FROM living_patients)
  GROUP BY c.subject.patientId
),
single_condition_patients AS (
  SELECT patientId
  FROM patient_condition_counts
  WHERE num_distinct_conditions = 1
),
single_condition_info AS (
  SELECT 
    c.subject.patientId,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patientId FROM single_condition_patients)
),
patient_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    mr.subject.patientId,
    mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as med_code,
    mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as med_display,
    mr.medication.codeableConcept.text as med_text
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
    AND mr.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patientId FROM single_condition_patients)
),
patient_condition_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    sci.condition_code,
    sci.condition_display,
    sci.patientId,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(pm.med_code, '|', pm.med_text)) as num_active_meds
  FROM single_condition_info sci
  JOIN patient_meds pm ON sci.patientId = pm.patientId
  GROUP BY sci.condition_code, sci.condition_display, sci.patientId
),
condition_max_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    condition_code,
    condition_display,
    MAX(num_active_meds) as max_active_meds
  FROM patient_condition_meds
  GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display
)
SELECT 
  condition_code,
  condition_display,
  max_active_meds
FROM condition_max_meds
ORDER BY max_active_meds DESC, condition_code ASC
LIMIT 8

SELECT 
  CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS date,
  temp AS avg_temp
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2009`
WHERE stn = '723758' AND mo = '10' AND temp != 9999.9
ORDER BY temp DESC

-- Get all gaps at month 214 or higher
WITH user_monthly_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    `by` as username,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH) as activity_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full`
  WHERE timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2024-09-10')
    AND `by` IS NOT NULL
    AND `by` != ''
  GROUP BY `by`, activity_month
),
user_activity_range AS (
  SELECT 
    username,
    MIN(activity_month) as first_month,
    MAX(activity_month) as last_month
  FROM user_monthly_activity
  GROUP BY username
),
user_all_months AS (
  SELECT 
    username,
    first_month,
    last_month,
    GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(first_month, last_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) as month_array
  FROM user_activity_range
),
flattened_months AS (
  SELECT 
    username,
    first_month,
    last_month,
    month_val,
    DATE_DIFF(month_val, first_month, MONTH) + 1 as month_number
  FROM user_all_months,
  UNNEST(month_array) as month_val
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    fm.username,
    fm.month_val,
    fm.month_number,
    fm.first_month,
    fm.last_month
  FROM flattened_months fm
  LEFT JOIN user_monthly_activity um ON fm.username = um.username AND fm.month_val = um.activity_month
  WHERE um.activity_month IS NULL
)
SELECT username, month_number, month_val, first_month, last_month,
       DATE_DIFF(last_month, first_month, MONTH) + 1 as total_months
FROM gaps

WITH combined AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
),
averages AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewpoint,

  FROM combined

    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL

  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month,
  (ABS(avg_air - avg_wetbulb) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dewpoint) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) +

WITH 
sorafenib_targets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157
      AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
target_pe AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
    WHERE pe.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets)
),
all_pe_with_tas AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ptp.pe_stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptp
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON ptp.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
    WHERE ptp.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND pv.lowest_level = TRUE
),
targets_in_universe AS (
    SELECT pe.stable_id
    FROM target_pe pe
    WHERE pe.stable_id IN (SELECT pe_stable_id FROM all_pe_with_tas)
),
pathway_pe AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ptp.pathway_stable_id, ptp.pe_stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptp
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON ptp.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
    WHERE ptp.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND pv.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.pathway_stable_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as a,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NULL THEN 1 END) as c
    FROM pathway_pe pp
    LEFT JOIN targets_in_universe tp ON pp.pe_stable_id = tp.stable_id
    GROUP BY pp.pathway_stable_id
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targets_in_universe) as total_targets,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_pe_with_tas) as total_all_pe
),
chi_sq_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.pathway_stable_id,
        pv.name as pathway_name,
        pc.a as targets_within,
        tc.total_targets - pc.a as targets_outside,
        pc.c as non_targets_within,
        (tc.total_all_pe - tc.total_targets) - pc.c as non_targets_outside,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            tc.total_all_pe * POWER(
                (pc.a * ((tc.total_all_pe - tc.total_targets) - pc.c)) - 
                ((tc.total_targets - pc.a) * pc.c),
                2
            ),
            SAFE_MULTIPLY(tc.total_targets, SAFE_MULTIPLY(tc.total_all_pe - tc.total_targets, SAFE_MULTIPLY(pc.a + pc.c, (tc.total_targets - pc.a) + (tc.total_all_pe - tc.total_targets) - pc.c)))
        ) as chi_sq
    FROM pathway_counts pc
    CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON pc.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        pathway_stable_id, 
        pathway_name, 
        targets_within, 
        targets_outside, 
        non_targets_within, 
        non_targets_outside,
        chi_sq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY chi_sq DESC) as rn
    FROM chi_sq_calc
)
SELECT pathway_stable_id, pathway_name, chi_sq as chi_squared, targets_within, targets_outside, non_targets_within, non_targets_outside
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3

    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_value != ''
    AND SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
),
mol_stats AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno,
    COUNT(*) as act_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dup_count
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
  HAVING COUNT(*) < 5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 2
),
qualifying_mols AS (
  SELECT q.activity_id, q.assay_id, q.standard_type, q.molregno, q.standard_value, q.standard_relation, q.doc_id, q.heavy_atoms, q.canonical_smiles
  FROM mol_stats ms

),
assay_groups AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type
  FROM qualifying_mols
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type

),
doc_info AS (
  SELECT doc_id, journal, year, first_page,
    SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) as doc_year,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, year ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64)) as rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, year) as grp_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT doc_id,
    COALESCE(doc_year, 1970) as doc_year,
    SAFE_CAST(CASE WHEN grp_count > 1 THEN FLOOR((rn - 1.0) / (grp_count - 1) * 11) + 1 ELSE 1 END AS INT64) as doc_month,
    SAFE_CAST(CASE WHEN grp_count > 1 THEN MOD(CAST(FLOOR((rn - 1.0) / (grp_count - 1) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 ELSE 1 END AS INT64) as doc_day
  FROM doc_info
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT q1.molregno as molregno1, q2.molregno as molregno2,
         q1.activity_id as activity_id1, q2.activity_id as activity_id2,
         q1.assay_id, q1.standard_type,
         q1.standard_value as std_val1, q2.standard_value as std_val2,
         q1.standard_relation as rel1, q2.standard_relation as rel2,
         q1.doc_id as doc_id1, q2.doc_id as doc_id2,
         q1.heavy_atoms as ha1, q2.heavy_atoms as ha2,
         q1.canonical_smiles as smiles1, q2.canonical_smiles as smiles2
  FROM qualifying_mols q1
  JOIN qualifying_mols q2 ON q1.assay_id = q2.assay_id AND q1.standard_type = q2.standard_type
  JOIN assay_groups ag ON q1.assay_id = ag.assay_id AND q1.standard_type = ag.standard_type
  WHERE q1.molregno < q2.molregno
),
with_all AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    IF(ha1 > ha2, ha1, ha2) as max_heavy_atoms,
    d1.doc_year as dy1, d1.doc_month as dm1, d1.doc_day as dd1,
    d2.doc_year as dy2, d2.doc_month as dm2, d2.doc_day as dd2
  FROM pairs p
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates d1 ON p.doc_id1 = d1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates d2 ON p.doc_id2 = d2.doc_id
),
with_dates AS (
  SELECT wa.*,
    CASE WHEN dy1 > dy2 THEN 1
         WHEN dy1 < dy2 THEN 2
         WHEN dm1 > dm2 THEN 1
         WHEN dm1 < dm2 THEN 2
         WHEN dd1 >= dd2 THEN 1
         ELSE 2
    END as latest_idx
  FROM with_all wa
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total
FROM with_dates

WITH scoring_events AS (
  SELECT 
    game_id,
    period,
    game_clock,
    elapsed_time_sec,
    team_name,
    team_market,
    points_scored,
    event_description,
    event_type,
    event_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
    AND points_scored > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT 
    game_id,
    period,
    game_clock,
    elapsed_time_sec,
    team_name,
    team_market,
    points_scored,
    event_description,
    event_type,
    event_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN team_market = 'Kentucky' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS kentucky_cumulative,
    SUM(CASE WHEN team_market = 'Notre Dame' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS notre_dame_cumulative
  FROM scoring_events
)
SELECT 
  game_clock,
  kentucky_cumulative AS wildcats_score,
  notre_dame_cumulative AS fighting_irish_score,
  team_name AS scoring_team,
  event_description
FROM scored
ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id

WITH top_venues AS (
  SELECT 
    'Top Venues' AS category,
    'N/A' AS date,
    venue_name AS matchup_or_venue,
    venue_capacity AS key_metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams`
  WHERE venue_capacity IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY venue_capacity DESC) <= 5
),
championship_margins AS (
  SELECT 
    'Biggest Championship Margins' AS category,
    CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS date,
    CONCAT(h_name, ' vs ', a_name) AS matchup_or_venue,
    ABS(h_points - a_points) AS key_metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
  WHERE tournament_type = 'National Championship'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(h_points - a_points) DESC) <= 5
),
highest_scoring AS (
  SELECT 
    'Highest Scoring Games' AS category,
    CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS date,
    CONCAT(h_name, ' vs ', a_name) AS matchup_or_venue,
    (h_points + a_points) AS key_metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
  WHERE season > 2010
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (h_points + a_points) DESC) <= 5
),
total_threes AS (
  SELECT 
    'Total Threes' AS category,
    CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS date,
    CONCAT(h_name, ' vs ', a_name) AS matchup_or_venue,
    (h_three_points_made + a_three_points_made) AS key_metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
  WHERE season > 2010
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (h_three_points_made + a_three_points_made) DESC) <= 5
)
SELECT * FROM top_venues
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM championship_margins
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM highest_scoring
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM total_threes
ORDER BY category, key_metric DESC

  GROUP BY traffic_source.medium, traffic_source.source
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
    WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
    WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
    WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
    WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
    WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
    WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
    WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
    WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
         AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Search'
    WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp')
         AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Social'
    WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
         AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Video'
    WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
         AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
    WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
    WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp') 
         OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
    WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch') 
         OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%video%' THEN 'Organic Video'
    WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
    ELSE 'Unassigned'
  END AS channel,
  SUM(session_count) AS total_sessions
FROM traffic
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

),
cohort_shanghai AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,

    DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(first_open_utc), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) as first_open_date_shanghai
  FROM cohort

cohort_events AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.user_pseudo_id,
    cs.first_open_date_shanghai,
    DATE_DIFF(

      cs.first_open_date_shanghai,
      DAY
    ) as days_after_first_open
  FROM cohort_shanghai cs
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON cs.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180902' AND '20180928'
    AND e.event_timestamp > cs.first_open_utc
),
retention_flags AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.user_pseudo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ce.days_after_first_open BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week1_retained,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ce.days_after_first_open BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week2_retained,

    ON cs.user_pseudo_id = ce.user_pseudo_id
  GROUP BY cs.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week1_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week2_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week3_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_3_retention_rate
FROM retention_flags
